# Nova API — /api/samples

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/samples`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## POST /api/samples/\{name\}

Operation id `samples_load`: in Python `client.call("samples_load", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api samples_load`.

Load one generated sample table as the caller. `trips` is the only sample: about 10 000 deterministic rows in `<catalog>.samples.trips`, generated by the engine, so it works on every profile and in an air-gapped install. Idempotent: a second call creates nothing and answers `created: false`. `?catalog=` picks the catalog; omitted, the caller's default one is used. Nothing is ever dropped.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `catalog` | query | string | No | Catalog to work in (`warehouse`, `finance`, …). Omitted, the default catalog is used. |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | Sample name; `trips` is the only one |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The sample was already there; `created` is false |
| `201` | The sample was created; `rows` is its row count |
| `400` | The engine refused the statement, or the catalog name is invalid |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | The caller may not browse that catalog |
| `404` | No such sample, or no such catalog |
| `502` | The query engine is not reachable |
